headline: China's Premier Li Qiang condemns US-Israeli war on Iran as 'blatant aggression' at SCO Dushanbe'
dek: Li called the attacks 'blatant aggression' carried out during negotiations without UNSC authorization; reaffirmed opposition to unilateral US sanctions; backed reviving the Islamabad Agreement; pledged China would defend Iran's 'legitimate rights' in international forums; urged return to dialogue.…
sources: IRNA (Iran state news); meeting: Li Qiang + Iranian First VP Mohammad Reza Aref, sidelines of 25th SCO Council of Heads of Government meeting, Dushanbe
fault_line: China's shield for Iran — real great-power backing, or profitable neutrality while Tehran bleeds?

sections.what_happened: Li called the attacks 'blatant aggression' carried out during negotiations without UNSC authorization; reaffirmed opposition to unilateral US sanctions; backed reviving the Islamabad Agreement; pledged China would defend Iran's 'legitimate rights' in international forums; urged return to dialogue. Russia PM Mishustin at same SCO event prioritized expanding trade with Iran and the International North-South Transport Corridor. Iran's priorities at SCO: trade, transport, logistics, AI, advanced tech.
sections.what_verified: IRNA English, Press TV (citing Xinhua), Tehran Times, Gulf News, Al Jazeera liveblog, lifenewsagency (Mehr sourcing), zot.news. President Xi Jinping separately said the Middle East war caused serious losses and did not serve global interests (Daily Star via Gulf News).
sections.what_disputed: Beijing's support remains political/diplomatic/economic — no military backing pledged (Asia News Network); Gulf News notes China's emphasis is not direct intervention. Trump simultaneously claims Russia and China are 'laying off' Iran — direct contradiction in framing.
sections.why_matters: The SCO axis in daylight: Beijing names the war for what it is — aggression without a UN mandate — while Moscow and Tehran talk corridors and trade. The truth from the side of truth.
sections.context: Background: China's Premier Li Qiang condemns US-Israeli war on Iran as 'blatant aggression' at SCO Dushanbe

totw_analysis: Our read: The SCO axis in daylight: Beijing names the war for what it is — aggression without a UN mandate — while Moscow and Tehran talk corridors and trade. The truth from the side of truth. The fault line our audience is arguing over: China's shield for Iran — real great-power backing, or profitable neutrality while Tehran bleeds?
